source.notes: ICSE Class IX school second semester examination paper (school not named). Header prints 'SECOND SEMESTER EXAMINATION 2024-25 (English Medium)', 'Class - IX', 'MATHEMATICS', 'Time : 2½ hrs.', 'M.M.- 80'; examYear 2025 is the later year of the printed session (also the year in the file name). PDF pages 3 and 4 are scanned out of order: PDF page 4 carries Questions 3 a) to 5 b) and PDF page 3 carries 5 c) to 9 b); the `page` field is the PDF page. Section A (40 Marks, attempt all): Question 1 (fifteen MCQs) prints only a group total [15] and is kept as one entry; several fractions in Question 1 are smudged on the scan and are marked [illegible]. Question 3 prints a single bracket [5] between parts b) and c) (assigned to b)); 3 a), 3 c), 5 a), 5 b) and 5 c) print no marks (recorded as 0, LOW). Section B: attempt any four of Questions 4-10, so the pack's marks total exceeds 80. Area-theorem (6 c)) and construction (7 c)) items have no matching chapter and have chapter null. The PDF has no text layer (watermark only); text was OCRed with RapidOCR and corrected against the page images (notation rebuilt from the images). Handwritten ticks/crosses are ignored. Figures are not reproduced. No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.

questions.sectionTitle: SECTION - A (40 Marks) Attempt all questions from this section
questions.text:
Choose the correct answers to the questions from the given options:
i) The slope of the line 3x - 2y + 5 = 0. a) [illegible] b) 1 c) [illegible] d) 2
ii) If cos²θ = [illegible], then the value of sin²θ is: a) [illegible] b) [illegible] c) [illegible] d) ½
iii) If a - b = 4 and a + b = 6 than what is the value of a² + b² a) 52 b) 26 b) 24 d) 46
iv) The surface area of a cuboid is 148 cm². If the length is 5cm and width is 6cm, the value of height is a) 2 b) 3 c) 4 d) 5
v) If the diagonal of a square is 10 units, its area is a) 25 square units b) 75 square units c) 50 square units d) 100 square units
vi) The median of first ten prime numbers is a) 8 b) 10 c) 12 d) 14
vii) The value of expression (3^(a+2) + 3^(a+[illegible])) / (4 × 3^a − 3^a) is a) 3 b) 9 c) 4 d) 8.
viii) In the equation log_7, (2x²-1)=2 the value of x is a) 49 b) 50 c) 7 d) 5
ix) In ΔABC, M is midpoint of AB and a straight line through M and parallel to BC cuts AC at N. Find the length AN if BC = 7 cm and AC = 5 cm. a) 3.5 cm b) 5.2 cm c) 5.3 cm d) 2.5 cm
x) At what rate of compound interest per annum will a sum of Rs. 1200 become Rs. 1348.32 in 2 years? a) 7.5% b) 7% c) 6.5% d) 6%
xi) Assertion(A): The mean of 5 observation is 30. On excluding one of these observations, the mean of the remaining observation is increased to 31, the excluded observation is = 5X30-4X31=150-124=26 Reason (R): excluded observation is =5X31-4X30=155-120=35 a) A is true, R is false b) A is false, R is true c) Both A and R are true d) Both A and R are false
xii) In Δ ABC, cot ((A+B)/[illegible]) is equal to: a) ) tan [illegible] b) cos [illegible] c) cot [illegible] d) sin [illegible]
xiii) The sum of the interior angles of a regular hexagon is a) 180° b) 360° c) 540° d) 720°
xiv) The length of the chord which is at distance is 6 cm from the center of the circle whose radius is 10cm is a) 12cm b) 16cm c) 10cm d) 8cm
xv) A triangle and parallelogram are between the same parallels on same bases then if area of parallelogram is 176 cm², area of triangle is a) 68cm² b) 78cm² c) 88cm² d) 98cm²
extractionIssues: Only a group total (15) is printed for the fifteen MCQs i)-xv); kept as one entry with the options in the text
Illegible on the scan: the fractions in i) options a) and c), ii) the value of cos²θ and options a)-c), part of the exponent in vii), and the denominators in xii) are smudged; shown as [illegible]
